title: Deployment
viz_content: SELECT replace_all(deployment_id, char(39), '') AS deployment FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_time > now() - 30d AND deployment_id != '' GROUP BY deployment_id ORDER BY max(event_time) DESC LIMIT 50

title: Model request latency over time
description: Median, 95th and 99th percentile of the model request time, in seconds.
viz_content: SELECT time, percentile, seconds FROM ( SELECT to_datetime(int_div(to_unix_timestamp(event_time), greatest(60, int_div(date_diff('second', now() - {{filter_time_range}}, now()), 60))) * greatest(60, int_div(date_diff('second', now() - {{filter_time_range}}, now()), 60))) AS time, round(quantile(0.5)(metric_value) / 1000, 2) AS p50, round(quantile(0.95)(metric_value) / 1000, 2) AS p95, round(quantile(0.99)(metric_value) / 1000, 2) AS p99 FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_metrics) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') AND ('{{filter_deployment}}' = 'all' OR deployment_id = '{{filter_deployment}}') AND metric_name = 'llm.latency_ms' GROUP BY time) ARRAY JOIN ['p50', 'p95', 'p99'] AS percentile, [p50, p95, p99] AS seconds ORDER BY time

title: Model request latency distribution
description: How many model requests took how long, by agent type.
viz_content: SELECT *, concat(to_string(latency), ' ', to_string(agent_type)) AS k FROM (SELECT multi_if(metric_value < 1000, 0, metric_value < 2000, 1, metric_value < 5000, 2, metric_value < 10000, 3, metric_value < 20000, 4, metric_value < 30000, 5, metric_value < 60000, 6, metric_value < 120000, 7, 8) AS i, multi_if(metric_value < 1000, 'under 1 s', metric_value < 2000, '1 to 2 s', metric_value < 5000, '2 to 5 s', metric_value < 10000, '5 to 10 s', metric_value < 20000, '10 to 20 s', metric_value < 30000, '20 to 30 s', metric_value < 60000, '30 to 60 s', metric_value < 120000, '60 to 120 s', 'over 120 s') AS latency, agent_type, count() AS requests FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_metrics) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') AND ('{{filter_deployment}}' = 'all' OR deployment_id = '{{filter_deployment}}') AND metric_name = 'llm.latency_ms' GROUP BY i, latency, agent_type) ORDER BY i

title: Turn duration by agent type
description: Median and 95th percentile of the time from a prompt to the last event of its turn, in seconds.
viz_content: SELECT *, concat(to_string(agent), ' ', to_string(percentile)) AS k FROM (SELECT agent, percentile, seconds FROM ( SELECT agent, round(quantile(0.5)(seconds), 1) AS p50, round(quantile(0.95)(seconds), 1) AS p95 FROM (SELECT any(agent_type) AS agent, date_diff('second', min(event_time), max(event_time)) AS seconds FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') AND ('{{filter_deployment}}' = 'all' OR deployment_id = '{{filter_deployment}}') AND if(agent_type = 'claudecode', json_value(raw_event_data, '$.prompt_id'), run_id) != '' GROUP BY session_id, if(agent_type = 'claudecode', json_value(raw_event_data, '$.prompt_id'), run_id) HAVING count_if(event_type = 'user_input') > 0) GROUP BY agent) ARRAY JOIN ['p50', 'p95'] AS percentile, [p50, p95] AS seconds ORDER BY agent) ORDER BY seconds DESC

title: Model request errors and retries
description: Model requests that failed or were retried (Codex), and turns that an API error ended (Claude Code), over time.
viz_content: SELECT *, concat(to_string(time), ' ', to_string(kind)) AS k FROM (SELECT format_datetime(to_datetime(int_div(to_unix_timestamp(event_time), greatest(60, int_div(date_diff('second', now() - {{filter_time_range}}, now()), 60))) * greatest(60, int_div(date_diff('second', now() - {{filter_time_range}}, now()), 60))), '%m-%d %H:%M') AS time, multi_if(hook_name = 'stop_failure', 'turn ended by an API error', json_value(event_data, '$.status') NOT IN ('', 'completed') OR json_value(event_data, '$.error') NOT IN ('', 'null'), 'model request failed', to_int64_or_zero(json_value(event_data, '$.attempt_number')) > 1, 'model request retried', '') AS kind, count() AS events FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_hook_events) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') AND ('{{filter_deployment}}' = 'all' OR deployment_id = '{{filter_deployment}}') AND hook_name IN ('post_model_request', 'stop_failure') AND multi_if(hook_name = 'stop_failure', 'turn ended by an API error', json_value(event_data, '$.status') NOT IN ('', 'completed') OR json_value(event_data, '$.error') NOT IN ('', 'null'), 'model request failed', to_int64_or_zero(json_value(event_data, '$.attempt_number')) > 1, 'model request retried', '') != '' GROUP BY time, kind ORDER BY time) ORDER BY time

title: Slowest model requests
description: The eight model requests that took the longest in the selected window.
viz_content: SELECT event_time AS time, round(metric_value / 1000, 1) AS seconds, tags['model'] AS model, agent_type, session_id FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_metrics) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') AND ('{{filter_deployment}}' = 'all' OR deployment_id = '{{filter_deployment}}') AND metric_name = 'llm.latency_ms' ORDER BY metric_value DESC LIMIT 8

title: Reliability by agent type
description: Model requests and tool calls, and how many failed.
viz_content: SELECT e.agent AS agent, m.model_requests AS model_requests, h.failed_requests AS failed_requests, h.retries AS retries, h.turns_ended_by_error AS turns_ended_by_error, e.tool_calls AS tool_calls, e.failed_calls AS failed_tool_calls, round(100 * e.failed_calls / greatest(e.tool_calls, 1), 1) AS tool_failure_pct FROM (SELECT to_string(agent_type) AS agent, count_if(event_type = 'tool_complete') AS tool_calls, count_if(event_type = 'tool_complete' AND NOT tool_success) AS failed_calls FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') AND ('{{filter_deployment}}' = 'all' OR deployment_id = '{{filter_deployment}}') GROUP BY agent) AS e LEFT JOIN (SELECT to_string(agent_type) AS agent, count_if(metric_name = 'llm.call') AS model_requests FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_metrics) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') AND ('{{filter_deployment}}' = 'all' OR deployment_id = '{{filter_deployment}}') GROUP BY agent) AS m ON m.agent = e.agent LEFT JOIN (SELECT to_string(agent_type) AS agent, count_if(multi_if(hook_name = 'stop_failure', 'turn ended by an API error', json_value(event_data, '$.status') NOT IN ('', 'completed') OR json_value(event_data, '$.error') NOT IN ('', 'null'), 'model request failed', to_int64_or_zero(json_value(event_data, '$.attempt_number')) > 1, 'model request retried', '') = 'model request failed') AS failed_requests, count_if(multi_if(hook_name = 'stop_failure', 'turn ended by an API error', json_value(event_data, '$.status') NOT IN ('', 'completed') OR json_value(event_data, '$.error') NOT IN ('', 'null'), 'model request failed', to_int64_or_zero(json_value(event_data, '$.attempt_number')) > 1, 'model request retried', '') = 'model request retried') AS retries, count_if(multi_if(hook_name = 'stop_failure', 'turn ended by an API error', json_value(event_data, '$.status') NOT IN ('', 'completed') OR json_value(event_data, '$.error') NOT IN ('', 'null'), 'model request failed', to_int64_or_zero(json_value(event_data, '$.attempt_number')) > 1, 'model request retried', '') = 'turn ended by an API error') AS turns_ended_by_error FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_hook_events) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND ('{{filter_agent}}' = 'all' OR agent_type = '{{filter_agent}}') AND ('{{filter_deployment}}' = 'all' OR deployment_id = '{{filter_deployment}}') AND hook_name IN ('post_model_request', 'stop_failure') GROUP BY agent) AS h ON h.agent = e.agent ORDER BY tool_calls DESC LIMIT 8
